  > Hermes runs outside the repo (%LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes) and sends every LLM call through a local OmniRoute gateway; its state.db has token counts but no cost (cost_status unknown) and no link to tasks. Added agent-evaluate/ (kept separate from agent-history/): `bun run agent:evaluate` reads Hermes state.db (932 compaction duplicates dropped), OmniRoute call_logs (~4.8k upstream attempts on production-key), agent-history outcomes, the task list and the Cheaper Inference billing export, all read-only, and writes out/steps.jsonl (gitignored; hashes and error classes only), runs/tasks/providers/billing CSVs and reports/hermes_observability_report.md. Findings on 19-26 Sep: 29% of tokens successful, 5.6% wasted, 57% overhead outside task branches; pass@1 90.9% over 22 resolved Hermes tasks. Cheaper Inference billed $4.29 (the brief's example rate would give $9.29) but for 14.4% more tokens than OmniRoute received (flagged): OmniRoute gives up after ~17 s while successful calls take up to ~28 s (p95), and deepseek-v4-flash-0731 has exactly as many extra billed requests as timeouts (74). github, grok-cli, claude and opencode fail most of their fallback attempts. 16 of 20 Hermes history entries claim session times that do not overlap Hermes' real activity on the task branch. Built in a temporary worktree, then moved into the main folder at the operator's request and replayed on master 383b61f. By then Hermes had deleted its main CLI session (20260925_102231_0062d7), so the committed report attributes 31% of tokens to no turn; the figures above are from the 05:04Z run.
